Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — helpful call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on procurement:

- Use case: MedPrime wants LLM inference for patient triage routing (PHI in scope for some workflows).
- Compliance asks you raised: SOC 2 Type II report, HIPAA support/BAA, and GDPR DPA + appropriate SCC module for EU transfers.

3) We’ll provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short security questionnaire response. Please send the vendor questionnaire you mentioned; I’ll route it internally. (Action: Hannah)
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review the DPA redline and SOC 2 artifacts. (Action: Olivia/Hannah — propose slots)

Attachments: I’ve attached a short checklist of items we’ll include in the DPA and a placeholder DPA template for your review.

If the role alignment is correct (MedPrime = Controller, Redwood = Processor) we’ll default to the Processor-to-Controller SCC module unless legal suggests otherwise. Happy to adapt.

Hannah — thanks for the context and the draft. Quick legal guidance:

1) Roles and DPA
We can accept MedPrime as Controller and Redwood as Processor. The standard Redwood DPA will suffice as the base, but we need an addendum with explicit PHI handling clauses (encryption, access controls, logging retention) and heightened breach notification timelines (24 hours). I will prepare redline edits and a short addendum.

2) SCC module selection
Recommend attaching the Controller-to-Processor SCC module (commonly referenced as the Processor module in the EU SCC set). This aligns with MedPrime's expectation and is the cleanest mapping for our architecture. We will include standard technical and organizational measures as an Annex.

3) SOC 2 and evidence
We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a secure read-only link to our security evidence bundle. Please provide the contact email for MedPrime security to share the link (security@medprime.com was cc'd). I will not include HSM/KMS keys but will document KMS integrations and encryption-at-rest details.

4) Timeline and next steps
- I will produce a redlined DPA + SCC annex and upload it to DocuSign for easy review by COB Thu (11 Feb) Redwood time. (Action: Laura)
- Hannah, please confirm the agreed follow-up slot with Olivia (Wed 18:00 CET / Thu 10:00 CET) and we’ll aim for Thu 10:00 CET to give us one more cycle if needed. (Action: Hannah)
